Author: Sandro
Name: NahjaUI
Punchline: A complete, modular interface for Final Fantasy XIV.
Description:
NahjaUI gives the game a clean, consistent interface that you build piece by piece. Switch on only what you want: everything else stays exactly as the game made it.

HUD bars: your parameter bar, target, target of target, focus target and party list.
Progress bars: your casts and your target's, with a slidecast marker, plus a global cooldown bar that shows the queue and weave windows.
Job gauges, status effects, nameplates and enmity list, each one with its own style.
Trackers: pick the enhancements, enfeeblements and cooldowns you want to see. Every job comes with ready-made presets.
Profiles: save, copy and share your whole setup.

Type /nui to open it.

Join the testers on Discord: https://nahjaui.github.io/discord
Changelog: Added: Black Mage Thunderhead and Firestarter auras, shown while the buff is on (also while you are a Thaumaturge). Added: a soft white Pulse effect for tracker triggers, switched on by default for the effects of the Black Mage trackers. Added: a Raising indicator on the party list: while someone casts a raise on a dead member, the text changes and the icon of the spell shows. Added: members of a cross-world party now show in the party list (the ones near you with full data, the others without HP). Changed: the Black Mage gauge also shows as Thaumaturge. Astral Fire and Umbral Ice have no timer, their pips follow your level, and Umbral Hearts, Polyglot and Astral Soul only show once you can use them. Changed: NahjaUI no longer has its own interface scale or Pixel perfect option: everything follows the scale of Dalamud and positions are in logical pixels, so you may need to place things again. Changed: Unlock Mode panel has width, height and anchors, its Attach to list is alphabetical, elements cannot leave the screen, and party, alliance and enmity lists anchor by their whole box. Changed: the Thunder tracker and the Rotation upkeep filter of the Black Mage include Thunder II, Thunder IV and High Thunder II. Fix: War Rotation trackers no longer show in Unlock Mode on other classes.
